name: size-formatter
description: Converts byte counts to human-readable strings (B, KB, MB, GB, TB) and parses them back to byte counts.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to display file sizes or data transfer amounts in a human-friendly format, or when parsing user-provided size strings into numeric byte values.

parameters.name: bytes
parameters.description: The number of bytes to format.

parameters.name: decimals
parameters.description: Number of decimal places in the output (default: 2).
